turns.text: Hello, I want to return a print and get the money back. I ordered the wrong size.
I can help with that. Please send me the order number (like SC-1234) and the email the order was placed with, so I can verify it.
The order is SC-3744 and the email is claire.fontaine@example.com.

Thank you, Claire, you're verified. This refund is large, so I can't file it myself and a person has to decide. I've passed your request to a colleague, who will take over. For reference, catalogue prints can be returned within 14 days of delivery, and the customer pays the return postage.

rule.ro: Printurile din catalog se pot returna în 14 zile de la livrare. Clientul plătește transportul retur. Rambursarea trebuie aprobată de echipă.
rule.en: Catalogue prints can be returned within 14 days of delivery. The customer pays the return postage. Staff must approve the refund.

input.summary: Verified customer Claire Fontaine (claire.fontaine@example.com) wants to return order SC-3744 (Last Lantern, limited, 40x50 cm, 1350 RON, delivered 2026-11-09) for a refund because she ordered the wrong size. Policy check flags large_refund, so staff must decide.
